description: Adds a song to the calling account's PRIVATE notebook. `song` is the canonical pivot payload: exactly the object returned by jj_get_song (`song`) or by a conversion whose output is "songbook", so converting then filing is a copy with no transformation. The id is DERIVED, never random: `song.id` if given, otherwise an "artist-title" slug. That means posting the same song twice REPLACES it instead of creating a duplicate, and it is also how you rewrite a song wholesale (read it with jj_get_song, edit the payload, post it back with its id). Adding NEVER publishes anything on the public profile. Consumes one unit of the daily WRITE quota (200/day free, 5000 Premium).

playlistIds.description: COMPLETE target state of playlist membership, not a delta: the song joins the playlists listed and LEAVES every other one. [] removes it from all of them. Omit to leave memberships untouched.

publish.description: NOT ACCEPTED HERE, and passing it is an error rather than a no-op. Adding a song and publishing it on a public profile are two different decisions: publish afterwards with jj_update_song, once the person has said which rights declaration applies.

song.description: Canonical pivot payload. `title` is required and non-empty; `artist`, `sections[].lines[].lyrics`, `sections[].lines[].chords[] = { offset, chord }`, `detectedKey { tonic, scale }` and `metadata { capo, bpm }` are the usual fields. Validated by the same gate as a .jamsong import in the app; hard cap 512 KB.

name: jj_create_song
title: Add a song to my notebook
